pages: Aster Labs fictional office-supplies purchasing policy, current from 2026-01-01. Purchases totaling at most 5000 JPY require line-manager confirmation. Higher totals require department-head confirmation. Submit an item list, the total budget and the required manager confirmation. This policy describes the process and does not grant approval automatically.

Aster Labs fictional training policy, current from 2026-01-01. Submit a training request at least 3 calendar days before the course start date. Required documents are the course schedule and line-manager approval. The advance-notice requirement uses calendar days, not working days.

Aster Labs fictional commuting allowance policy, current from 2026-01-01. Eligibility requires full-time employment and at least 3 on-site workdays per week. Submit an employment-type declaration and an on-site work schedule. Self-reported facts can support only a conditional eligibility assessment, subject to employer confirmation.
